questions: What should happen for n=0? Should it return an empty list, raise an error, or something else?
Is the index i in the returned list zero-based (so element at index 0 corresponds to i=1) or one-based (so element at index 1 corresponds to i=1)?
For the sum of figures from 1 to i, does 'figures' mean digits of i or numbers from 1 to i?
Should the factorial of 0 be considered for even i? Since i starts from 1, but factorial definition includes 1 to i.
Is the input n guaranteed to be a non-negative integer, and if not, how should non-integer or negative inputs be handled?
For large n, is there any concern about integer overflow or performance expectations?
Should the function use recursion or iteration? Does the implementation method matter?
Are there any constraints on the maximum value of n for which the function must work correctly?
